# frontend-revamp — Test Coverage Baseline (2026-06-08)

External-audit prep, hub-only scope. Established as a reference point for the
external review — **not** a regression gate (the repo defines no coverage
threshold). Captured with the patched toolchain (vitest 4.1.8).

## How it was run

```bash
cd frontend-revamp
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
# abis/*.json is gitignored + auto-generated by smart-contract-revamp/bin/sync-to-services.sh;
# a fresh checkout needs it populated (copy from a synced checkout, or run the sync) or
# the use-deposit / use-flag-collateral suites fail to resolve "@/../abis/*.json".
TZ=UTC pnpm run test:coverage     # vitest run --coverage (v8 provider)
```

Provider: `@vitest/coverage-v8` (added as a devDependency in this same change —
it was previously absent, so coverage could not be produced before).

## Results

- **Test suites:** 57 passed / 57
- **Tests:** 678 passed / 678
- **Runner:** vitest 4.1.8 (jsdom env)

### Overall coverage

| Metric | Coverage | Covered / Total |
|---|---|---|
| Statements | **81.69%** | 1214 / 1486 |
| Branches | **70.52%** | 713 / 1011 |
| Functions | **83.05%** | 299 / 360 |
| Lines | **82.93%** | 1123 / 1354 |

### By area (statements / branches / functions / lines)

| Area | Stmts | Branch | Funcs | Lines | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `src/lib` | 84.3% | 73.8% | 82.0% | 85.3% | API/config/health-factor/utils — well covered |
| `src/hooks` | 78.7% | 66.3% | 85.1% | 80.3% | core form/data/chain hooks |
| `src/components/ui` | 84.6% | 66.7% | 81.8% | 84.6% | shadcn primitives in use |
| `src/components` | 57.1% | 26.7% | 50.0% | 58.3% | lowest area — see below |

### Lowest-covered files worth flagging to the auditor

- `src/lib/api.ts` — **32.8% stmts** (largest source file; many endpoint branches
  unexercised). The thin API surface, not core logic.
- `src/components/*-surface.tsx` — **16.7% stmts** (presentational shell, minimal
  unit coverage).
- `src/hooks/use-borrow-form.ts` — **48.7% stmts** (complex form-state branches).
- `src/hooks/use-deposit.ts` / `use-lend-form.ts` — ~69–74% (on-chain interaction
  branches partially covered).

Health-factor logic (`src/lib/health-factor.ts`, **96.5%**) and order-error
mapping (`order-errors.ts`, **100%**) — the safety-relevant paths — are the
best-covered, which is the right shape for a lending UI.

## Disposition

This is a **baseline snapshot only**. No new tests were written and no behavior
changed in this audit-prep pass. Overall ~82% line coverage with the
safety-critical HF and error-mapping paths near-complete. Lower-coverage areas
(`api.ts`, presentational surfaces) are candidates for follow-up test work but are
out of scope for this scan.
